data.title: US Army unit rotation in Estonia to resume in November 2026 after interruption - Janes
data.content: The Estonian Ministry of Defence (MoD) announced in a press release on 23 September 2026 that US representatives have informed Estonia that the rotational presence of US forces in the country would continue with a new unit arriving in November. Estonian Defence Minister Martin Herem said, “Estonia highly values the US presence in Estonia and its contribution to ensuring security in the Baltic region. The Estonian MoD added that US representatives had said the decision was separate from the Pentagon's force posture review, adding that the unit arriving in Estonia would be equivalent in size and capability to the unit that rotated out in the second quarter of 2026. That unit was the 6th Squadron, 9th Cavalry Regiment (6/9 CAV), whose rotation was followed by a temporary suspension due to the ongoing review of the US military force structure. The task force and the US Army's V Corps trained and prepared Estonians on the High Mobility Artillery Rocket System (HIMARS).
